query: Among female ICU patients aged 88–98 on high‑flow nasal cannula, are there any GCS totals recorded on ICU day 2 or later, and if so what is the median?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY gcs_total) AS median_gcs_total FROM (SELECT gcs_total FROM chartevents JOIN icustays ON chartevents.subject_id = icustays.subject_id AND chartevents.hadm_id = icustays.hadm_id JOIN patients ON icustays.subject_id = patients.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_age BETWEEN 88 AND 98 AND icustays.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND chartevents.itemid = 154871 AND chartevents.charttime >= icustays.intime + interval '2 days') AS subquery;
